title: Lundey Worker component diagram
description: The Lundey Worker: one fetch handler that lets invited, signed-in players through to the static game and turns everyone else away. It stores nothing.

components.name: Lundey Worker
components.responsibility: Serves the game's files to holders of games:lundey.

components.name: Fetch handler (index.ts)
components.responsibility: Sends the bare address to its slash, refuses other paths and methods, asks the sign-in library for games:lundey, serves the asset privately, and writes the not-invited page.

components.name: Sign-in (vendor/icelander-auth)
components.responsibility: The shared library: reads the site_session cookie, asks the login service who holds it, and answers with the player or with a redirect to /auth/sign-in on this host (requireRole).

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in, and which games: roles they hold (service binding ACCOUNTS).

components.name: Cloudflare static assets
components.responsibility: The built files from dist/, with the response headers from _headers (binding ASSETS).
